parameters.content:
## AI Security Alert Deduplication Engine

### How it works

This workflow ingests security alerts from SIEM, EDR, and cloud security webhooks, normalizes them, and stores them in a temporary alert buffer. On a scheduled batch window, it retrieves recent buffered alerts, fingerprints and pre-clusters them, then uses Claude only for ambiguous clusters while clear clusters pass through directly. The resolved clusters are merged into unified security cases, sent to a ticketing system, and announced to the security team in Slack.

### Setup steps

- Configure the three webhook URLs in the upstream SIEM, EDR, and cloud security platforms so they send alert payloads to the matching n8n webhook triggers.
- Review and adapt each normalization Code node so the incoming alert schemas map to the same canonical fields, such as source, title, severity, entity, timestamp, indicators, and raw event data.
- Add credentials and endpoint details for the alert buffer API used by the store and fetch HTTP Request nodes.
- Set the Cron batch schedule to the desired deduplication window, and make sure the fetch request queries the same time window from the buffer service.
- Configure Anthropic credentials for the Claude clustering agent and select the intended model in the Anthropic chat model sub-node.
- Add ticketing-system API credentials and adjust the create/update endpoint, payload, and case matching fields.
- Connect Slack credentials and choose the channel or user group that should receive security case notifications.

## SIEM alert intake

Receives SIEM alerts through a webhook and normalizes them into the shared alert format before sending them into the common ingestion stream.

## EDR alert intake

Receives endpoint detection and response alerts and converts them into the workflow’s canonical alert structure.

## Cloud alert intake

Receives cloud security alerts and normalizes them so they can be deduplicated together with the other alert sources.

## Buffer normalized alerts

Combines the normalized alerts from all three intake lanes and posts each alert into the external buffer service for later batch processing.

## Fetch batch window

Starts the scheduled deduplication cycle and retrieves alerts accumulated in the buffer during the most recent processing window.

## Fingerprint and route

Extracts the buffered alert list, computes fingerprints, performs initial pre-clustering, and routes ambiguous clusters toward AI review while sending clear clusters down the direct path.

## Resolve ambiguous clusters

Uses a Claude-powered agent to semantically cluster ambiguous alert groups, then applies the AI result back to the workflow’s cluster structure.

## Pass clear clusters

Handles pre-clusters that were already considered unambiguous, preserving them without sending them through the AI resolution branch.

## Merge cluster outputs

Recombines the AI-resolved ambiguous clusters and the directly passed clear clusters into one unified cluster result stream.

## Create cases and notify

Builds unified security case records from the final clusters, creates or updates cases in the ticketing system, and notifies the security team in Slack.
